# ![](https://app.gusto.com/companies/54e407dd-cfce-48c4-9576-36b45033b4dc/logo?v=1779418044)    Liv Data LLCDigital Marketing & Growth Specialist Co-op  Jersey City, NJ  ·   Intern  [Company website](https://www.livdatallc.com/)    [Apply for Digital Marketing & Growth Specialist Co-op](https://jobs.gusto.com/postings/liv-data-llc-digital-marketing-growth-specialist-co-op-18e1db99-806f-4ea5-b06c-757c5f913af0/applicants/new)

We are looking for an enthusiastic, creative and hands-on marketing professional who can help grow Liv Data's brand and generate business opportunities. You will work across social media, content creation, marketing materials, HubSpot, email campaigns, WordPress, SEO and sales development. You will also bring ideas for videos, photography, interviews and campaigns that make our services and people more visible. This role suits someone who enjoys learning, takes initiative and can move from an idea to a finished campaign. You will work closely with leadership and our finance and technology teams to turn their expertise into clear, engaging content.

### About Liv Data LLC

Built on Real-World Finance Experience

Liv Data was built on the idea that finance consulting should be practical. Too often, companies work with a financial advisory firm that delivers recommendations without staying involved through execution. The result is a gap between strategy and reality, where initiatives stall, systems remain underutilized, and finance teams continue to operate under pressure.

Our team comes from hands-on experience across FP&A, accounting, and finance transformation. We’ve worked inside finance teams, not just alongside them. That perspective shapes how we operate today, as a financial advisory firm focused on delivering real business outcomes.

### Description

# **Responsibilities:**

**Social Media and Content Creation:**

• Manage Liv Data's presence across LinkedIn, Instagram and Facebook.

• Build a content calendar covering services, educational content, team stories, company updates and approved

client outcomes.

• Create platform-specific posts, carousels, reels, stories and short videos.

• Write captions, articles, scripts and interview questions in a consistent brand voice.

• Engage with relevant audiences and manage comments and inquiries.

• Identify useful trends and campaign ideas that fit Liv Data's audience and business goals.

• Repurpose interviews, webinars and project insights into multiple content formats.

**Content Shoots, Photography and Video:**

• Propose content-shoot ideas, including leadership interviews, service explainers, team introductions and

behind-the-scenes stories.

• Prepare simple scripts, storyboards, shot lists and recording plans.

• Coordinate shoots with the US and India teams, including guiding colleagues through remote recording.

• Capture photographs and video where practical, and edit material supplied by other team members.

• Apply basic framing, lighting, audio, photo-editing and video-editing skills.

• Organize reusable photos, footage and branded assets.

• Obtain appropriate approvals before publishing people, client information or project material.

**Marketing Materials and Brand Communication:**

• Create brochures, service one-pagers, presentations, case studies, infographics and sales materials.

• Translate finance, AI and data topics into clear language for business leaders.

• Maintain consistent branding across digital channels, documents and presentations.

• Support webinars, events, newsletters and thought-leadership campaigns.

HubSpot and Email Marketing

• Manage HubSpot contacts, segmentation, forms, workflows and CRM data quality.

• Create newsletters, targeted email campaigns and lead-nurturing sequences.

• Connect website and campaign inquiries to the right follow-up process.

• Track lead sources, campaign responses and sales activity.

• Test messaging and calls to action to improve results.

• Follow appropriate consent, unsubscribe and contact-management practices.

**WordPress Website and SEO:**

• Build and update WordPress pages and landing pages using Elementor or similar tools.

• Maintain website content, forms, links, booking flows and marketing integrations.

• Improve navigation, mobile usability and conversion paths.

• Conduct keyword research and improve page titles, descriptions, headings, internal links and content.

• Monitor search visibility and identify technical SEO issues.

• Coordinate with technical support on hosting, security, backups, performance and complex development.

• Test changes before publishing them to the live website.

Lead Generation and Sales Development

• Identify target companies and decision-makers relevant to Liv Data's services.

• Run targeted campaigns and personalized outreach to generate qualified leads.

• Respond to inquiries, qualify opportunities and arrange introductory meetings.

• Participate in initial sales conversations and explain Liv Data's services clearly.

• Prepare tailored presentations, proposals and follow-up materials with leadership.

• Help move qualified opportunities toward signed engagements.

• Support approved paid campaigns across relevant channels, including LinkedIn, Google and Meta.

**Reporting and Improvement:**

• Track website traffic, search performance, social engagement, email results and conversions.

• Measure qualified leads, booked meetings and marketing's contribution to sales opportunities.

• Use results and sales feedback to improve campaigns.

• Share clear updates on priorities, progress, blockers and next steps.

# **Qualifications:**

**Required Skills and Experience:**

• Hands-on digital marketing experience, supported by a portfolio.

• Strong writing, storytelling and communication skills.

• Experience creating content for LinkedIn, Instagram and Facebook.

• Ability to design professional marketing materials using Canva, Adobe tools or similar platforms.

• Basic photography, video-shoot planning and short-form video-editing skills.

• Practical experience with HubSpot, email marketing and lead nurturing.

• Hands-on WordPress experience and working knowledge of SEO.

• Familiarity with Google Analytics, Google Search Console and campaign tracking.

• Confidence communicating with prospects and supporting sales activities.

• Ability to organize work, meet deadlines and collaborate across time zones.

**Preferred Experience:**

• B2B marketing for finance, consulting, technology or professional services.

• Campaigns targeting CFOs, finance leaders, founders or business owners.

• Elementor, basic HTML/CSS and website integrations.

• Paid advertising, webinars and executive thought-leadership content.

• Proposal development and service-based sales.

• Responsible use of AI tools for research and content production, with human review for accuracy and

confidentiality.

**What We Look For:**

• Enthusiasm for building a brand and learning how the business works.

• Initiative to suggest ideas and take them through execution.

• Curiosity about finance, AI, data and automation.

• Creativity supported by good judgment and attention to detail.

• A focus on business outcomes — not only followers and impressions.

• Comfort receiving feedback, experimenting and improving.

• Ownership and collaboration in a small, growing team.

**What the Role Offers:**

• Direct collaboration with Liv Data's leadership, finance and technology teams.

• Exposure to real finance, AI, data and automation work.

• Space to contribute creative ideas and see their business impact.

• Opportunities to take on broader responsibilities as the company grows.

#### Salary

$16 - $22 per hour

[Apply for Digital Marketing & Growth Specialist Co-op](https://jobs.gusto.com/postings/liv-data-llc-digital-marketing-growth-specialist-co-op-18e1db99-806f-4ea5-b06c-757c5f913af0/applicants/new)
